review_locator: PMCID:PMC3432803, Activation of B cells by non-canonical helper signals; PMCID:PMC3262910, B-helper neutrophils stimulate immunoglobulin diversification and production in the marginal zone of the spleen
primary_title: B-cell-helper neutrophils stimulate immunoglobulin diversification and production in the marginal zone of the spleen
decision_basis: The review identifies the Puga primary showing that human splenic B-cell-helper neutrophils release APRIL and that TACI-Ig blockade inhibits marginal-zone B-cell IgM production.
limitations_preserved: Mediator-supported functional bridge; preserve APRIL release and TACI-dependent contribution in the human splenic neutrophil-to-MZ-B-cell context, do not infer APRIL transcript/translation or sole mediator necessity, and do not infer SCI or terminal-TF effects.
